text:
Here is my use case: Use Grokbot to create a daily usage report on my son's use of technology.  

https://x.ai/bot/Dc0ZGUypwwBQZE9pNxLYy 

It started out, as a way to track my son's YouTube usage.  He's allowed 4 videos a day that are not educational.  This traces whether he skips videos as best as possible.  

The problem, is that you can't trace run times specifically. But, it can infer based on starting a new video within second or minute.  

It also looks at Google Family, Amazon Family, and Meta family, and Game Changer to get a daily report.  This bot I created goes well beyond that into Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo, and more.  

This is built out from my personal version that has this functionality plus it sends it via email to my wife, and when it sends to my wife it ALSO creates a cute little meme based on the calendar of what is happening. The next day.  I also have it check the Audible daily sale and it lets me know if a new general Audible sale starts.

I have another bot that looks at the classes I teach and tests them.  IT makes sure links work and everything is in place.  It looks 2 weeks and 1 week out.
